import zipfile, shutil, os

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
entries = {i.filename: i for i in z.infolist()}

sheet = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

# --- styles.xml: add custom percentage format 0.0% (numFmtId=164) and style index 3 ---
assert '<numFmts count="0"/>' in styles
styles = styles.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
assert '<cellXfs count="3">' in styles
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">')
assert '</cellXfs>' in styles
styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs>')

# --- sheet1.xml: dimension, column width, header, formulas ---
assert 'ref="A1:G10"' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"')

assert '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>')

# Header H1 (style s=1 like other headers)
assert '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>')

# Data rows 2-9: H = Profit / Revenue (style 3 = 0.0%)
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = (f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
           f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>')
    assert old in sheet, old
    sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# TOTAL row 10: overall margin = total profit / total revenue
old = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
assert old in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old,
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
    '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>')

# --- write new workbook preserving other parts ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for info in z.infolist():
        if info.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            out.writestr(info, sheet)
        elif info.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            out.writestr(info, styles)
        else:
            out.writestr(info, z.read(info.filename))
z.close()

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("OK - added Profit Margin % column H")

import zipfile
import os
import re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data.tmp.xlsx'

def col_letter(ref):
    m = re.match(r'([A-Z]+)', ref)
    return m.group(1) if m else ''

def col_index(letters):
    n = 0
    for ch in letters:
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return n

def make_cell(ref, formula=None, style=None, header_text=None):
    c = ET.Element('{%s}c' % NS)
    c.set('r', ref)
    if style is not None:
        c.set('s', str(style))
    if header_text is not None:
        c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, '{%s}is' % NS)
        t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, '{%s}t' % NS)
        t_el.text = header_text
    else:
        f = ET.SubElement(c, '{%s}f' % NS)
        f.text = formula
    return c

def reorder_cells(row):
    cells = row.findall('{%s}c' % NS)
    cells.sort(key=lambda c: col_index(col_letter(c.get('r') or '')))
    for c in cells:
        row.remove(c)
    for c in cells:
        row.append(c)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in zin.infolist()}

root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sheet_data = root.find('{%s}sheetData' % NS)
rows = {int(r.get('r')): r for r in sheet_data.findall('{%s}row' % NS)}

# Header: ensure H1 = "Profit Margin %" with header style (s=1)
hdr = rows[1]
hcell = next((c for c in hdr.findall('{%s}c' % NS) if col_letter(c.get('r') or '') == 'H'), None)
if hcell is None:
    hdr.append(make_cell('H1', style=1, header_text='Profit Margin %'))
else:
    hcell.set('s', '1')
    hcell.set('t', 'inlineStr')
    is_el = hcell.find('{%s}is' % NS)
    if is_el is None:
        is_el = ET.SubElement(hcell, '{%s}is' % NS)
    t_el = is_el.find('{%s}t' % NS)
    if t_el is None:
        t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, '{%s}t' % NS)
    t_el.text = 'Profit Margin %'
reorder_cells(hdr)

# Data rows: H{r} = G{r}/E{r} with percentage style (s=3, numFmt 0.0%)
for rn in list(range(2, 10)) + [10]:
    row = rows[rn]
    hc = next((c for c in row.findall('{%s}c' % NS) if col_letter(c.get('r') or '') == 'H'), None)
    if hc is None:
        row.append(make_cell('H%d' % rn, 'G%d/E%d' % (rn, rn), style=3))
    else:
        hc.set('s', '3')
        f = hc.find('{%s}f' % NS)
        if f is None:
            f = ET.SubElement(hc, '{%s}f' % NS)
        f.text = 'G%d/E%d' % (rn, rn)
    reorder_cells(row)

dim = root.find('{%s}dimension' % NS)
if dim is not None:
    dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        if name == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            zout.writestr(name, ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True))
        else:
            zout.writestr(name, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('profit margin column ensured in sales_data.xlsx')

import zipfile
import os
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data.tmp.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in zin.infolist()}

root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sd = root.find('{%s}sheetData' % NS)
rows = {int(r.get('r')): r for r in sd.findall('{%s}row' % NS)}

def set_cell(row, ref, formula, style, text=None):
    cells = row.findall('{%s}c' % NS)
    cell = None
    for c in cells:
        if c.get('r') == ref:
            cell = c
            break
    if cell is None:
        cell = ET.SubElement(row, '{%s}c' % NS)
        cell.set('r', ref)
    cell.set('s', str(style))
    if text is not None:
        cell.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_el = ET.SubElement(cell, '{%s}is' % NS)
        t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, '{%s}t' % NS)
        t_el.text = text
    else:
        if 't' in cell.attrib:
            del cell.attrib['t']
        f = cell.find('{%s}f' % NS)
        if f is None:
            f = ET.SubElement(cell, '{%s}f' % NS)
        f.text = formula

set_cell(rows[1], 'H1', None, 1, text='Profit Margin %')
for rn in range(2, 10):
    set_cell(rows[rn], 'H%d' % rn, 'G%d/E%d' % (rn, rn), 3)
set_cell(rows[10], 'H10', 'G10/E10', 3)

dim = root.find('{%s}dimension' % NS)
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        if name == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            zout.writestr(name, ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True))
        else:
            zout.writestr(name, data)
os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('sales_data.xlsx updated with Profit Margin % column')

import os, sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "sales_data.xlsx"
if not os.path.exists(path):
    sys.exit("File not found: %s" % path)

wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active
headers = [(i + 1, c.value) for i, c in enumerate(ws[1])]

def find_col(keys, exclude=None):
    for idx, h in headers:
        if h is None:
            continue
        hl = str(h).strip().lower()
        if exclude and any(e in hl for e in exclude):
            continue
        if any(k in hl for k in keys):
            return idx
    return None

existing_margin = find_col(["profit margin", "margin %", "margin%"])
profit = find_col(["profit", "net income", "income", "earnings"], exclude=["margin"])
cost = find_col(["cost", "cogs", "expense", "goods sold"])
rev = find_col(["revenue", "net sales", "sales", "price"])

if rev is None:
    sys.exit("No revenue/sales column found")

new_col = existing_margin if existing_margin else (ws.max_column + 1)
header_cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col, value="Profit Margin (%)")
header_cell.font = Font(bold=True)

for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    rc = ws.cell(row=r, column=rev).coordinate
    if profit is not None:
        formula = "=IF(OR(%s=\"\",%s=0),\"\",%s/%s)" % (
            rc, rc, ws.cell(row=r, column=profit).coordinate, rc)
    elif cost is not None:
        cc = ws.cell(row=r, column=cost).coordinate
        formula = "=IF(OR(%s=\"\",%s=0),\"\",(%s-%s)/%s)" % (rc, rc, rc, cc, rc)
    else:
        sys.exit("Need a profit or cost column to compute margin")
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col, value=formula)
    cell.number_format = "0.0%"

wb.save(path)
print("Added 'Profit Margin (%)' at %s (revenue col %s, profit col %s, cost col %s)"
      % (ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col).coordinate, rev, profit, cost))

import zipfile, shutil, os

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
entries = {i.filename: i for i in z.infolist()}

sheet = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

# --- styles.xml: add custom percentage format 0.0% (numFmtId=164) and style index 3 ---
assert '<numFmts count="0"/>' in styles
styles = styles.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
assert '<cellXfs count="3">' in styles
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">')
assert '</cellXfs>' in styles
styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs>')

# --- sheet1.xml: dimension, column width, header, formulas ---
assert 'ref="A1:G10"' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"')

assert '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>')

# Header H1 (style s=1 like other headers)
assert '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
    '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>')

# Data rows 2-9: H = Profit / Revenue (style 3 = 0.0%)
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = (f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
           f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>')
    assert old in sheet, old
    sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# TOTAL row 10: overall margin = total profit / total revenue
old = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
assert old in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old,
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
    '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>')

# --- write new workbook preserving other parts ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for info in z.infolist():
        if info.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            out.writestr(info, sheet)
        elif info.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            out.writestr(info, styles)
        else:
            out.writestr(info, z.read(info.filename))
z.close()

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("OK - added Profit Margin % column H")

import zipfile
import os
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data.tmp.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in zin.infolist()}

root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sd = root.find('{%s}sheetData' % NS)
rows = {int(r.get('r')): r for r in sd.findall('{%s}row' % NS)}

def set_cell(row, ref, formula, style, text=None):
    cells = row.findall('{%s}c' % NS)
    cell = None
    for c in cells:
        if c.get('r') == ref:
            cell = c
            break
    if cell is None:
        cell = ET.SubElement(row, '{%s}c' % NS)
        cell.set('r', ref)
    cell.set('s', str(style))
    if text is not None:
        cell.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_el = ET.SubElement(cell, '{%s}is' % NS)
        t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, '{%s}t' % NS)
        t_el.text = text
    else:
        if 't' in cell.attrib:
            del cell.attrib['t']
        f = cell.find('{%s}f' % NS)
        if f is None:
            f = ET.SubElement(cell, '{%s}f' % NS)
        f.text = formula

set_cell(rows[1], 'H1', None, 1, text='Profit Margin %')
for rn in range(2, 10):
    set_cell(rows[rn], 'H%d' % rn, 'G%d/E%d' % (rn, rn), 3)
set_cell(rows[10], 'H10', 'G10/E10', 3)

dim = root.find('{%s}dimension' % NS)
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        if name == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            zout.writestr(name, ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True))
        else:
            zout.writestr(name, data)
os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('sales_data.xlsx updated with Profit Margin % column')
